policy: Evidence is model-specific and scope-limited. A deterministic software snapshot is never independent source reproduction. Source-equation checks do not prove external clinical predictive performance.

entries.sourceLocation: Roberts et al. (2011), final population model equations (3)-(4), Table 2
entries.population: 206 critically ill adults receiving vancomycin by continuous infusion
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment zero-order input: CL=4.58*(CRCL/100), V=1.53*WT, C(t)=rate/CL*(1-exp(-CL*t/V)), 0<t<=infusion duration.
verifiedScope: published structural equation
published typical fixed effects
renal and weight covariates
unit conversion
population concentrations for a single continuous infusion
Source-reported OMEGA/SIGMA scales checked against frozen mrgsolve matrices (including reported-CV conversion discrepancy)
Synthetic two-ETA MAP posterior independently optimized from analytical 1-compartment C(t), log heteroscedastic Gaussian observation variance and diagonal Gaussian prior; compared to mapbayr
exclusions: No stochastic distributional goodness-of-fit on original individual participant data; IIV CV conversion discrepancies are printed
No author-original MAP individual EBEs, covariance validation, or original-clinical-cohort reanalysis
entries.testedMapScope: Independent optimization of source-informed diagonal Gaussian prior and concentration-dependent observation variance against mapbayr on a single synthetic patient, without using implementation-generated trajectories as expected outcomes

entries.sourceLocation: Revilla et al. (2010), final covariate model; Table 4
entries.population: Adult ICU patients treated with intravenous vancomycin
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment IV bolus: CL=(0.67*(CRCL/WT)+AGE^(-0.24))*WT*0.06, V=0.82*2.49^(CREAT_umolL/88.4>1)*WT, C(t)=dose/V*exp(-CL*t/V).
scenarios: higher renal clearance and older age
verifiedScope: published structural equation
published typical fixed effects
age and renal effects
serum-creatinine threshold
conversion of kg-normalized mL/min clearance to L/h
population concentrations following an IV bolus

exclusions: No stochastic distributional goodness-of-fit on original individual participant data; IIV CV conversion discrepancies are printed
No author-original MAP individual EBEs, covariance validation, or original-clinical-cohort reanalysis

entries.sourceLocation: Goti et al. (2018), Methods page 8 (Cockcroft-Gault preprocessing) and Table 2 page 27 (final 2-compartment model)
entries.population: Hospitalized adults with and without intermittent hemodialysis
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent source implementation applies the age >60 serum-creatinine floor and 150 mL/min CrCl cap, then evaluates the published CL and V1 equations. The analytical IV-bolus solution uses k10=CL/V1, k12=Q/V1, k21=Q/V2 and the two disposition roots. AUC is independently checked from both biexponential coefficients and dose/CL. A separate three-ETA posterior objective is optimized independently and compared with mapbayr.
scenarios: male 50 years, weight 70 kg, creatinine 80 umol/L, without hemodialysis
female 55 years, weight 85 kg, creatinine 125 umol/L, with hemodialysis
older male 70 years, weight 75 kg, creatinine 110 umol/L, without hemodialysis
age 60 versus 61 years around the strict creatinine-floor age threshold
creatinine exactly 1 mg/dL in a patient older than 60 years
augmented renal clearance above and exactly at the 150 mL/min cap
three-ETA synthetic MAP case invoking both renal preprocessing rules
verifiedScope: published typical CL, V1, V2 and Q with static dialysis-status effects
Cockcroft-Gault sex/weight/age/creatinine units, strict age threshold, serum-creatinine floor and CrCl cap
published diagonal IIV CV values and combined residual-error values
independently calculated two-compartment bolus IV concentration-time solution and AUC
synthetic three-dimensional MAP objective versus an independent optimizer
exclusions: reproduction of source individual data or original empirical Bayes estimates
entries.testedMapScope: Independent optimization of the published diagonal Gaussian prior and combined observation variance against mapbayr on one synthetic renal-boundary patient; not a reproduction of source EBEs
